comment: Licence-compliance requirement — A managed service cannot grant rights absent from the applicable terms. Apply the published WHO terms of use for ICD-11 content and software (https://icd.who.int/en/docs/ICD11-license.pdf), as revised from time to time, separately to content and software; verify the terms in force at publication. Translations, mappings and supplementary metadata require source-specific treatment. See C037; unpublished draft agreements are not substituted for operative terms.

public.suggestedRevision: Replace whole cell; retain Required status: Licence compliance. The TS shall maintain source-specific licence and access metadata and implement the controls required by the applicable terms. It shall document responsibilities for the service operator and consuming systems, preserve attribution and source identifiers, and distinguish the permissions applying to original content, translations, mappings, supplementary metadata, and software. Access controls shall be applied where required by the relevant terms.
